sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
🌞 Morning (AM Care)

Spray Xtreme Phus Phus All Day Hair Regrowth Rice Mist evenly on scalp and hair. Gently massage with fingertips to stimulate roots and boost growth. Style your hair as usual.
🌙 Night (PM Care)

Apply Phus Phus Fermented Rice Hair Mist on scalp. Massage softly to nourish and repair overnight. Leave on and rinse or style next day as preferred.

 <div class="

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Can I use both mists daily?

Yes, the AM and PM mists are formulated for everyday use to provide continuous hair nourishment plus don't forget to massage in a circular motion for better penetration. 

Q2. Do I need to rinse after application?

No, both mists are leave-on — simply spray and let your hair absorb the nutrients.

Q3. How long before I see results?

Most users notice reduced hair fall and improved texture within 4-6 weeks of regular use.

Q4. Can I use it with oiling or serum?

Yes, but apply mists on clean scalp and use oils/serums after at least 2 hours for best absorption.

Q5. Is it safe for color-treated hair?

Absolutely — both mists are free from parabens, sulfates, and harmful chemicals, making them safe for treated hair.

Q6. When should I shampoo my hair?

You can shampoo your hair in the morning after using the PM Fermented Rice Mist overnight or as you see build-up or dirt on your scalp. For the AM Mist, shampooing isn’t required — just spray and go!
